column4: Define the audit boundary and acceptance criteria for decomposing the overloaded scripts/ directory; preserve the operator ask, identify current domains, and state that no files move before evidence.
Inventory scripts/ and adjacent code, classify entrypoints by runtime role, map callers/reflexes/tests/configuration, and record duplicate/dead-code candidates with evidence.

Using the inventory, propose a repository layout for core, communication, sensors/integrations, and operational wrappers; derive concrete migration tasks, dependency gates, rollback steps, and verification commands without performing unapproved bulk moves.
